entries.appliesTo: Tennessee advisory commission on intergovernmental relations (TACIR); state and local governmental entities must provide requested information

sources.program: § 1 — 'The Tennessee advisory commission on intergovernmental relations (TACIR) shall conduct a study of the potential regulation of artificial intelligence systems and generative artificial intelligence chatbots in this state.'

flags: study-and-report mandate does not fit any listed duty key: § 2 — 'TACIR shall publish a report of the study's findings and recommendations and shall deliver a copy of the report to the governor, the speaker of the senate, the speaker of the house of representatives, and the legislative librarian.'
cooperation duty on other government entities: § 3 — 'State and local governmental entities shall, to the extent permitted by law, provide information requested by TACIR.'
no report deadline stated; act 'takes effect upon becoming a law' (§ 4)
no appropriation: § 3 — 'TACIR shall conduct the study using TACIR's existing resources.'
no penalty or enforcement provision (exposure omitted)
substitution: the act states 'Substituted for: House Bill No. 1946' — SB 1700 is the enacted vehicle (Public Chapter No. 1082), not a duplicate
